item.title: Apple TV 4K Upgraded to A19 Chip, New Siri Remote
item.description: Apple's 2023 Apple TV 4K lands Oct 30 with an A19 chip, a speaker‑enabled Siri Remote, built‑in microphones for direct Siri, and a new HomePod mini.

item.title: Apple TV 4K Next‑Gen to Debut Upgraded Siri Remote
item.description: Apple’s upcoming Apple TV 4K will ship with a refreshed Siri Remote and likely run the A17 Pro chip, with a launch slated for September‑October 2026.
